hits.title: Quantifying the added value of human forecaster discussions for tropical cyclone intensity prediction
hits.abstract_snippet: The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This study examines the added value of these discussions for intensity forecasting beyond a set of numerical predictors. hits.title: How VLMs Plan What's Next
hits.abstract_snippet: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts.
